en:
## New Features

- Project knowledge base: collections, entries, revisions, and full-text search (with CJK support) are now built in. Narrators can search and read knowledge during a task, and proposed edits go through a copy-on-write draft + review flow instead of touching the published version directly.
- Dual-axis access control for the knowledge base: a classification-level (clearance) axis plus a controlled-tag (compartment) axis. A redesigned admin panel manages levels, tags, and per-user permissions across three views, with a live "who can access this entry" / "what this user can read" preview.
- Automatic knowledge hints: when a user message or tool output matches knowledge-base content, relevant entries are injected as context (keyword-extracted, ACL-filtered, with injection limits and an on/off switch).
- Resource packs: upload a tar.gz/zip pack and have the agent unpack it into an isolated directory and register it on the narrator's read/write allowlist, with zip-slip / zip-bomb / symlink protection.
- Background subagents can now report progress to the parent narrator via Send({ id: "parent" }), so long-running background work can surface intermediate updates.

## Bug Fixes

- Custom provider base URLs that need a `/v1` suffix are now persisted after a successful runtime fallback, and Anthropic model-list lookups fall back across candidate base URLs (including OpenAI-style `/v1/models` relays).
- Hardened streaming-chunk reassembly across multiple provider adapters.
- Numerous knowledge-base correctness fixes: enforced access checks on read/edit/delete paths, fail-closed classification resolution (unknown levels deny rather than silently drop to public), atomic version numbering under concurrent edits, and compare-and-set review merges that prevent duplicate revisions.

## Performance

- Tuned SQLite PRAGMAs (WAL synchronous=NORMAL, larger cache, memory temp store, mmap) to lower read latency and bound WAL growth.
- Knowledge list queries no longer read large content/metadata blobs in bulk, are capped and paginated, eliminate an N+1 in submission listing, and are backed by new composite indexes for sort order.
zh-CN:
## 新功能

- 项目知识库：内置集合、条目、修订与全文搜索（支持中文）。叙述者可在任务中搜索和阅读知识，提交的修改走写时复制的草稿 + 评审流程，不会直接改动已发布版本。
- 知识库双轴授权：密级（许可级别）轴 + 受控标签（分区）轴。全新的管理面板分密级、标签、用户三个视图管理权限，并提供「谁可访问此条目」「此用户可读哪些条目」的实时效果预览。
- 知识自动提示：当用户消息或工具输出命中知识库内容时，自动注入相关条目作为上下文（关键词提取 + ACL 过滤 + 注入上限 + 可开关）。
- 资源包：可上传 tar.gz/zip 资源包，由 agent 解压到隔离目录并注册进叙述者读写白名单，解压带 zip-slip / zip-bomb / 符号链接防护。
- 后台子代理可通过 Send({ id: "parent" }) 向父叙述者汇报阶段性进展，让长时间后台任务能及时暴露中间状态。

## 修复

- 自定义提供商 base URL 在运行时 `/v1` 回退成功后会持久化保存；Anthropic 模型列表查询会按候选 base URL 顺序回退（兼容把模型列表暴露在 OpenAI 风格 `/v1/models` 的第三方中继）。
- 加固多个提供商适配器的流式分片拼接。
- 多项知识库正确性修复：读/改/删路径强制访问校验、分级解析 fail-closed（未知密级拒绝而非静默降为 public）、并发编辑下版本号原子计算、审核合并采用 compare-and-set 杜绝重复修订。

## 性能优化

- 调优 SQLite PRAGMA（WAL synchronous=NORMAL、更大缓存、内存临时存储、mmap），降低读延迟并限制 WAL 增长。
- 知识库列表查询不再批量读取大正文/元数据字段，加上限与分页，消除审核列表的 N+1，并新增复合索引覆盖排序。
